hooks.command: fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); dir=$( [ -n "$fp" ] && dirname "$fp" || pwd ); branch=$(git -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$branch" = "master" ] && echo 'On master — cut a branch before editing (see .claude/rules/git-workflow.md)' >&2 && exit 2; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
case "$cmd" in
  *"git reset --hard"*|*"git clean -f"*|*"git checkout --"*|*"git checkout ."*|*"git restore "*) ;;
  *) exit 0 ;;
esac
case "$cmd" in
  *"git restore"*)
    case "$cmd" in
      *"--staged"*) exit 0 ;;
    esac
    ;;
esac
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null)
[ -z "$dirty" ] && exit 0
echo 'Working tree has uncommitted tracked changes -- a destructive git command would discard them. Stash first (git stash push -u -m "<tag>"); the branch or target being rebuilt may be disposable, the working tree never is. see .claude/rules/git-workflow.md' >&2
exit 2
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | xargs -r vp fmt > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; pr_state=$(gh pr view --json state 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.state // "none"' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$pr_state" ] && pr_state='none'; ctx="Branch: $branch | PR: $pr_state"; jq -n --arg ctx "$ctx" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: $ctx}}'
